reports.title: Lakefront Biotherapeutics Reports Nine Months 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update

guidance.heading: Financial Guidance
section: The Company expects its year-end 2026 cash and financial investments balance to be in the range of €2.0 to €2.05 billion. This guidance includes initiating a second €50 million share repurchase program, which was not considered in the previous guidance range.

Lakefront forecasts having at least €1.6 billion of its cash remaining for additional strategic transactions and other capital allocation priorities following funding the portfolio to first gamgertamig approval.

Lakefront expects to change the presentation currency of its consolidated financial statements for the year ending December 31, 2026, from the euro to the U.S. dollar, and to change the functional currency from the euro to the U.S. dollar effective January 1, 2027. These changes are intended to better reflect the increasingly U.S. dollar-denominated nature of the Company’s operations and financial profile.
All guidance figures assume a EUR/USD exchange rate of 1.175, consistent with year-end 2025 and prior guidance. As of September 30, 2026, the EUR/USD exchange rate was 1.1355.
These estimates are subject to change and depend on exchange rate fluctuations and future business development activity.
